headline: Bitcoin stayed just under $60,000 into Friday night even as US stocks had their biggest rally in over a year, leaving it below where the week began as US bitcoin funds close out a record month of withdrawals.

market.asOf: Bitcoin, ether and solana read from Business Upturn's report at 5:55pm ET Fri 27 Nov (22:55 UTC; 05:55 Bangkok Sat). Fear & Greed is CoinMarketCap's index as reported on 27 Nov. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: CoinMarketCap Fear & Greed: 9 (Extreme Fear), per CoinMarketCap Academy, 27 Nov.

stories.title: Bitcoin stays below $60,000 while Wall Street rallies, and is back under where the week began
stories.summary: Bitcoin briefly topped $61,000 on Friday, then slipped back under $60,000 and stayed there into the evening, even as US stocks posted their biggest rally in over a year. Earlier on Friday it was on course to end a seven-week losing streak; it is now below where the week opened, and the weekly candle closes on Sunday.
points: Bitcoin was at $59,772, down 1.20%, and ether at $1,657, down 1.84%, at 5:55pm ET on Friday, per Business Upturn.
Bitcoin briefly topped $61,000 before falling, while the S&P 500 rose 1.6% to 7,297.49 and the Nasdaq rose 2.3%, per The Motley Fool.
Bitcoin opened the week at $61,172, per CoinGecko's hourly data cited by CryptoTicker, so it is now below its weekly open; the weekly candle closes on Sunday.
Bitcoin is down about 20% in November; earlier on Friday, when it was higher, CoinDesk said it was on course to end seven straight weekly losses if the gain held to Sunday's close.
About $311.9 million of bets were liquidated (forcibly closed) on Binance, Bybit and OKX over 24 hours, and total crypto market value fell 3.74% to $2.08 trillion, per TokenPost.

stories.title: US bitcoin funds set a record for monthly withdrawals, and Strategy now trades below the value of its bitcoin before Monday's MSCI exit
stories.summary: Money pulled from US spot bitcoin funds in November is already a record. Bitcoin treasury company Strategy now trades below the value of the bitcoin it owns, and MSCI drops it from its indexes after Monday's close, which could prompt funds that track those indexes to sell some of its shares.
points: November outflows reached about $5.39 billion per Farside data, above the previous record of $4.51 billion set in June, per The Library.
The last day with data before Thanksgiving, Wed 25 Nov, was the seventh straight day of outflows: $453.0 million left bitcoin funds and $68.5 million left ether funds, per FinanceFeeds.
Strategy's shares hit a record discount to the bitcoin it holds, an mNAV of 0.88x, which JPMorgan called a sign of capitulation, per CoinMarketCap Academy.
MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million Strategy shares, 3.1% of its basic shares, and JPMorgan estimated about $2.8 billion of selling, per Cointelegraph.

stories.title: Binance's withdrawals are back to normal four weeks after its hack
stories.summary: Binance says the withdrawal freeze from its 29 October hack is fully lifted, with a few networks still paused for maintenance. The FBI blames North Korea for the hack.
points: Binance said the withdrawal suspension from the October security incident has been fully lifted; a small number of networks remain paused for maintenance, per Decrypt via Yahoo Finance.
Binance covered more than $6.34 billion of affected assets and pledged to rebuild its SAFU emergency fund to about $1 billion; token issuers have frozen about $2.85 billion, per Bitcoin Magazine.

The US Justice Department moved on 23 Nov to seize more than $1.1 billion in USDC frozen by Circle, per Bitcoin Magazine, and the FBI blames North Korea's TraderTraitor group, per Decrypt via Yahoo Finance.

sources.label: Decrypt via Yahoo Finance: Binance fully lifts withdrawal suspension

briefs.title: Fidelity files for a spot Chainlink fund
briefs.summary: Fidelity filed on 25 Nov for a LINK fund that would trade on Nasdaq and would not stake its tokens, per CoinMarketCap Academy.

briefs.title: Franklin's crypto index fund adds Hyperliquid
briefs.summary: HYPE joins the fund on or about 1 Dec as its benchmark's eighth holding, per CoinMarketCap Academy.

briefs.title: Warren and Van Hollen ask the SEC to drop its crypto rule
briefs.summary: The senators said the proposed rule would give crypto special treatment, with less oversight than traditional securities, per CoinMarketCap Academy.

briefs.title: Hackers hijacked bitcoin miners' computing power
briefs.summary: On 20 Nov an attacker forged internet routes and diverted hashrate from more than 1,000 sites to an imposter pool, per Gizmodo.

briefs.title: KuCoin delists Monero on Monday
briefs.summary: KuCoin removes its XMR spot pairs at 08:00 UTC on 30 Nov; withdrawals stay open until 31 Dec. Its pairs carried about 58% of tracked XMR volume, per Yahoo Finance.

briefs.title: Brazil's big banks plan a real-pegged stablecoin
briefs.summary: B3 with Itaú, Bradesco, Santander and others is building "Open BRL," backed 1:1 in reais and targeted for the first quarter of 2027, per CoinMarketCap Academy.

briefs.title: Spain lets its financial watchdog freeze crypto accounts
briefs.summary: A new decree lets Spain's financial intelligence unit freeze crypto accounts for up to 5 business days without a court order, from 25 Jan 2027, per Cointelegraph.

calendar.event: Binance Blockchain Week, Bangkok; Fed quiet period begins
calendar.note: At the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, per Khaosod English. The Fed's pre-meeting blackout runs from Sat 28 Nov to 11:59pm ET Thu 10 Dec under the Fed's published rule, so no Fed speeches are expected apart from scheduled testimony.

calendar.note: PROS and GRASS on Saturday 28; FF and CARDS on Sunday 29; GRVT, KMNO and GUN on Monday 30 (one tracker gives GUN on the 29th); EIGEN and SUI on Tuesday 1 Dec; M, BTW, ENA, 2Z and Q on Wednesday 2 Dec (M's date is disputed: Tokenomist shows 12 Dec); STO on Thursday 3 Dec; MMT and LA on Friday 4 Dec. calendar.event: OPEC+ ministerial meeting sets 2027 oil policy
calendar.note: Policy for next year will be settled at a full ministerial meeting on 29 Nov, per World Oil. Time not announced.
XMR spot pairs are removed at 08:00 UTC; withdrawals stay open until 31 Dec, per Yahoo Finance.
October was 55.3, per Economic Weekly. No consensus found.

calendar.event: Trump Media (DJT) noteholders can demand repayment
calendar.note: About $883.5 million of convertible notes are outstanding; the company holds about 15,649 bitcoin, of which 4,261 are pledged as collateral for the notes, per Bitcoin.com News.

calendar.event: MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR) from its indexes
calendar.note: Takes effect at the close on 30 Nov. MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million MSTR shares, about 3.1% of its shares; JPMorgan estimated about $2.8 billion of selling, per Cointelegraph. Metaplanet and Upexi are also being removed.

calendar.event: ISM manufacturing PMI (Nov), job openings (JOLTS, Oct); Fed's Bowman testifies to the House
calendar.note: ISM: consensus 55.2, October 55.5, per Economic Weekly. JOLTS: September was about 7.5 million, per the BLS. Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman is listed for the House Financial Services hearing on oversight of prudential regulators at 10:00am, per the Fed's calendar. Marvell reports after the close, per StockTitan.

calendar.event: ADP private payrolls (Nov); Salesforce and Snowflake earnings
calendar.note: ADP: consensus 80,000, October 86,000, per Economic Weekly. Salesforce and Snowflake report after the close, per StockTitan.

calendar.event: US jobless claims; ISM services PMI (Nov); Senate AI-chip export hearing
calendar.note: Claims: consensus 193,000, prior 189,000. ISM services at 10:00am: consensus 54.5, October 54.5. Both per Economic Weekly. The Senate Banking Committee holds "Protecting America's AI Advantage: Oversight of U.S. Export Controls" at 10:00am, per the committee; Fortune reported Nvidia's Jensen Huang was asked to appear on 3 Dec.
Consensus +90,000 jobs with unemployment at 4.1%; October was +165,000 and 4.1%, per Economic Weekly. Weekly bitcoin options on Deribit expire at 08:00 UTC (3:00am ET) every Friday, per Deribit.

calendar.event: Fed rate decision (meeting 8-9 Dec); press conference 2:30pm ET
calendar.note: Markets expect a rate hike, not a cut: CME FedWatch showed a 99.2% chance of a quarter-point hike early on 27 Nov, per Investing.com, and a 98.9% chance of any hike, per Daily Economics. The Fed's calendar lists the meeting on 8-9 Dec and the press conference at 2:30pm ET.
